title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in German
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5xwArPxERFNdAjYY2nKcc9)_

Part of #30512
Thread-read: 6720709854
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 加上德语（de）：平台对象、Studio 的元数据表单、Setup/Studio/Account 导航、系统概览仪表板和用户/组织记录页的内嵌文字，做法与已合并的 pt-BR（#31440）、ru（#31466）逐文件一致。
- 为什么改：de 是 #30512 要补的第六个语言（之后是 ko）。目前 de 用户在控制台里看到的 `sys_*` 标签全是英文。
- 风险与回滚：只新增 de 文件、注册行和测试里的语言列表；已有语言一个字节都不变（其余 26 个生成文件不在 diff 里）；新文字同样走 source-hash 回退。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/de.ts`（导航钉住项），`de.source-hashes.generated.ts`（155 条与英文相同的叶子，下面逐类列出），以及被 repeater-row-properties 拒绝后改为带父级名称的 9 个 `Name` 行（见 Acceptance notes）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/platform-objects && npx vitest run src/apps/translations/source-hash.test.ts src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：生成文件让 PR 超过 3000 行，需要席位契约复审 ACCEPT，然后请人工合并。

## What changes
- New `de` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `de.objects.generated.ts` (1698 leaves), `de.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `de.source-hashes.generated.ts` (155 deliberate byte copies of `en`, listed under Acceptance notes), the hand-authored `de.ts` (141 leaves) and `de.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 36 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts` (`System`, which is the German word as well).
- Wording pins, as #31233 lists them: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label (`Meine ausstehenden Genehmigungen`), `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label (`Zuweisungsregeln`), each `nav_settings_*` (including `nav_settings_access_policy`, `Zugriffsrichtlinie`) as its service-settings hub title, `nav_settings_hub` as the console's `backToHub` (`Alle Einstellungen`), and the four #30935 keys: `grp_account_ai_assistant` = `KI-Assistent`; both `nav_connect_agent` entries and `pages.connect_agent.label` = `KI-Assistenten verbinden`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-de.md` (patch).

## Tests
- `de` added beside `ru` to the locale lists of every test #31466 widened (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, bu-rename with `old: /Abteilung/`, the five identity copy tests, record-page tabs, null label, per-user stores, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `de`.
- No new negative pin, for the same reason as #31466: the plugin-audit twin test is outside this claim's file surface.

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated. The 155 byte copies of `en` the extract records fall into four groups:
  - German words spelled the same as English (109): `Name` ×29, `Status` ×9, `Namespace` ×6, `Version` ×4, `Import` ×4, `Branding`, `Navigation`, `Filter`, `Team` and `Token` ×3 each, `Widgets`, `Layout`, `Dataset`, `Position`, `Gantt`, `Kanban`, `Code`, `Migration`, `System` and `Revision` ×2 each, and one each of `Dashboard`, `Widget`, `Flow`, `Hook`, `Handler`, `Avatar`, `App`, `Teams`, `Tags`, `Info`, `Logo`, `Global`, `Patch`, `Backoff`, `Job`, `Drilldown`, `Schemas`, `Feeds`, `Shards`, `Element`, `Details (JSON)`, `Name / Host`.
  - Identifiers and header names (38): `ID` ×24, `API` ×2, `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`, `Message-ID`, `Cc`, `Bcc`, `Slug`, `Web`, `snake_case`, the SAML `urn:…:emailAddress` NameID format, and the `openid email profile` / `email` / `name` defaults.
  - Lowercase option values that are identifiers (3): `cron`, `dlq`, `api`.
  - The five JSON examples (5), kept verbatim as every locale keeps them.
- `repeater-row-properties` refused nine `Name` echoes in repeater rows, so each now names its parent: `Parametername` (action params), `Filtername` (dashboard global filters), `Dimensionsname` and `Kennzahlname` (dataset dimensions and measures), `Spaltenname` (field inline columns), `Variablenname` (flow and page variables), `Indexname` (object indexes) and `Blockname` (report blocks). The row IDs and several descriptions name their parent too (`Bereichs-ID`, `Knoten-ID`, `Kanten-ID`, `Widget-Beschreibung`, `Optionsbeschreibung`, …).
- Vocabulary follows the existing `de` plugin bundles: formal „Sie“, „…“ quotes, `Benutzer`, `Geschäftseinheit`, `Berechtigungssatz`, `Position`, `Warteschlange`, `Freigabe`, `Datensatz`, `Genehmigung`, `KI`, `Fähigkeit` (skill), `Werkzeug` (tool), `Systemberechtigung` (capability); hub titles exactly as service-settings spells them (`E-Mail-Versand`, `SMS-Versand`, `Dateispeicher`, `KI und Embedder`, `Datenlebenszyklus`, …).
- Business units are `Geschäftseinheiten`; no `sys_business_unit*` label says `Abteilung` (`bu-rename-consistency`).
- Deviation, as in #31466: no plugin-audit `de` twin of the #28107 activity-summary test, because plugin-audit is not in the claim's file surface.

## Verification
- `os i18n extract packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr,pt-BR,ru,de --fill=default --source-hashes --out=packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: a rerun regenerates the `de` bundles byte-identical (`md5sum -c`) and leaves the 26 other generated files unchanged (none of them is in the diff). `check-i18n-bundles --filter=platform-objects`: in sync (29 bundles).
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 120 files, 1886 tests passed. plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary` (6), plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` (5), service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` plus `translations` (156) and cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` (27) passed.
- platform-objects `typecheck`: exit 0. `check:app-nav-i18n`: OK (13 contributors, 10 locales, 2 apps).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at e16f19cc (rebased on `origin/main` 507b53c0): 68 derived families, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:nul-bytes`).
- Rebased onto `origin/main` 7d0b47ca (3 commits, none in platform-objects; service-settings gained translated settings keys): head 72391c44. The extract reran with no diff, `check-i18n-bundles` in sync, platform-objects `vitest run` 1886 passed, service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` plus `translations` 156 passed.
- `eslint` over the changed `.ts` paths (scoped, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0.
